title: Waveform laboratory
channel.file_scope: Use a separate recorded input range
channel.file_help: The channel can use a larger recorded range than the loaded original preview. Reads and processing remain bounded; choose a smaller range if the job exceeds its budget. File positions count stored samples, while source gaps retain their own clock positions. Original tracks show the loaded preview.
channel.file_ready: {count} processed samples · {rate} S/s · center {center} MHz. Input: {input_count} stored samples from file position {first}; original tracks retain their loaded preview. FIR delay {delay} original samples is compensated; incomplete support is discarded.
channel.reveal_original: Locate original sample at processed B
channel.selection_outside: The original selection does not overlap this channel input. The completed channel view is retained.
channel.outside_preview: This channel selection extends beyond the loaded original preview. The channel selection is retained; locate a processed point to load its original neighborhood.
channel.preview_loaded: The original neighborhood is loaded at processed B. The channel input, selection and exact processed cursor are retained.
sample.not_loaded: This source position is outside the loaded original preview. Locate processed B to load its original neighborhood.
channel.help: Apply the complete configuration to the selected immutable input. Passband and transition must fit the original and output Nyquist bands. The centered FIR discards incomplete support. Each track shows observations on its own clock: an original selection locates the next output-grid point; a processed selection locates the preceding original sample. Exact processed source coordinates remain shown. This operation cannot repair clipping or missing input.
channel.empty: Enable extraction in the Selected channel inspector and apply a complete configuration. Original observations remain available in their own tab.
channel.ready: {count} processed samples · {rate} S/s · center {center} MHz. FIR delay: {delay} original samples, compensated in timestamps; incomplete support discarded.
channel.error.configuration: The complete channel configuration is invalid. Check passband, transitions, offset and both sample rates. The previous completed result is retained.
channel.error.short: No continuous observed region is long enough for the selected FIR support. Load more source samples or use a wider transition. The previous result is retained.
channel.error.source_changed: The recorded channel input is unavailable or no longer matches its source metadata, immutable preview or saved input identity. The previous completed result is retained.
window.error.configuration: The complete window research configuration or selection is invalid. Check the FFT, hop, support and requested source. The previous completed result is retained.
window.title: Window research
window.complete: Window research completed. Its input, exact selection and spectral units are shown with the result.
window.empty: Enable window research in the inspector and apply it to an original or extracted-channel selection.
window.scope: {source} · first {first} · {count} clock positions · {frames} complete frames · RF reference {center} MHz · {unit}
window.view_help: Drag a time/frequency rectangle to prepare target-channel parameters and locate the original range. Nothing is applied to the receiver. The heatmap uses maximum power per pixel and the chosen display color limits. Spectrum values below −300 dB are displayed at −300 dB; absent complete frames remain blank.
window.statistics_help: Time statistics use every observed sample in the selection. Spectra average only complete windowed frames, with no DC removal or gap padding. Autocorrelation uses actual continuous pairs without DC removal. Invalid phase/frequency estimates are excluded. Passing amplitude checks does not establish a carrier, sufficient SNR or modulation; noise also has phase differences. dBFS uses normalized complex power with reference 1; no dBm calibration is assumed.
capture.idle: Capture stopped; completed analysis remains available.
capture.frozen_receiving: Receiving continues while the analysis window is frozen.
capture.freezing: Retaining the accepted sample prefix in the background…
capture.counts:
Accepted {accepted} · input rejected {rejected} · processing rejected {processing} · retention expired {expired}
Queued {queue} B · retained {retained} B
capture.budget: Retention is limited to 1 s, 8 MiB of normalized samples and 4,096 segments. The actual time span can be shorter. The raw queue has a separate 2 MiB / 128-block budget.
capture.help: The passband includes the complete signal and guards. Receiver plugins recommend, validate and read back the whole configuration. A conflict preserves existing tasks. The window shows the actual full input stream; a shared wideband input needs channel extraction before studying an isolated signal. Digital zoom cannot repair clipping or recover samples already discarded. Freezing does not release another receiver user.
capture.error: The receiver request failed. Check receiver selection and the complete configuration.
capture.reception_error: Reception ended or was rejected ({state}). Inspect the requested settings, actual readback and diagnostic below; other receiver users retain their own leases.
capture.processing_error: Some accepted input could not be normalized. The processing rejection count and source gaps remain visible.
capture.empty: No accepted samples were available for this window. The previous completed analysis remains displayed.
capture.loaded: Capture window: {count} available samples across {duration} ms of source clock. This window is in memory; source gaps remain absent. Receiver activity and retention continue independently.
source.capture: Capture window · {rate} MS/s · {center} MHz · source encoding {encoding}
save.reference_hint: Save the source reference, applied parameters and view. Keep the referenced I/Q files available.
save.capture_hint: Save the analysis and a segmented sample copy beside the configuration. Keep the configuration and its capture folder together.
save.saving: Saving and verifying the immutable analysis source in the background…
save.error.verification: The saved samples did not match the frozen window. The previous analysis is retained.
save.error.configuration_budget: The analysis configuration exceeds its 8 MiB budget. The previous analysis is retained.
save.error.budget: The capture exceeds the sample persistence budget. The previous analysis is retained.
save.error.with_capture: The configuration was not saved; a verified sample copy is available at {path}. The current analysis is retained.
save.canceled_with_capture: Configuration saving was canceled; a verified sample copy is available at {path}.
empty: Open an I/Q recording or inspect a recorded event.
measure.mark_a: Set A to current sample B
measure.help: Click or drag for B; Shift-click for A. Right-drag selects a range. Use the wheel or +/− to zoom; Home restores the loaded window. Measurements use original samples, not display buckets. Phase is unwrapped separately across invalid intervals. A wideband mixture is not an isolated signal.
sample.valid: Sample and adjacent frequency estimate can be computed. Amplitude checks passed; carrier evidence and SNR have not been assessed.
sample.missing: No source sample at this position; no interpolation is used.
sample.derived_invalid: Raw sample available; low amplitude or lack of a continuous predecessor makes some estimates unavailable.
options.title: Estimator parameters
plane.title: I/Q plane
plane.axes: Horizontal: I · vertical: Q · normalized components
plane.help: The selected time range is shared with the tracks. At sample scale, lines follow continuous samples; wider views show sample density. A/B identify the same source samples. Raw I/Q has not undergone symbol timing or carrier synchronization.
loading: Loading a bounded recording window in the background…
analyzing: Analyzing the same immutable samples in the background…
canceled.keep: Analysis canceled; the previous completed window is retained.
loaded: Loaded {count} samples ({duration} ms); recording contains {total} samples. Frequency offsets use the recording center; hardware continuity is not guaranteed by this analysis.
view.range: Shared time axis / ms · {count} source-clock positions · {duration} ms
saved: Current source identity, applied parameters, view and event context saved.
error.missing_source: The event has no available recording source.
error.operation: The research operation failed. The source recording is preserved.
error.range: Enter a nonnegative file sample and a positive sample count.
error.source_changed: The recording or selected samples have changed since this analysis was saved. The previous completed window, if any, remains displayed.
error.budget: The requested range exceeds the sample or analysis budget. Select a smaller range.
error.recording: The recording could not be read or analyzed. Check its format, range and availability; the previous completed window, if any, remains displayed.
error.capture: The frozen capture could not be analyzed. The previous completed window, if any, remains displayed.
error.save: The analysis configuration could not be saved.
error.configuration: The saved analysis configuration is invalid or uses an unsupported version.
error.view_restored: The samples were restored; invalid saved view settings were replaced by the loaded window.
recovery.title: Evidence and recovery
recovery.empty: Choose a recovery method and apply it to the current input view. Results retain their assumptions, stages and source support.
recovery.help: Parameters are a draft until applied. Known bytes remain candidates until the declared frame checks pass. Unknown bytes appear as ?? and cannot be exported as binary. Select an item to inspect its source support; double-click or use Locate to inspect the waveform. JSON preserves the evidence and its status.
recovery.no_selection: Select a frame, byte or value to inspect its input support.
recovery.selection: {count} value(s), {ranges} required input interval(s). Source {first} + {first_n}/{first_d} → {last} + {last_n}/{last_d}. Gaps remain unobserved.
recovery.byte_candidate: Known candidate byte. Its frame status and validation scope remain separate.
recovery.analyzing: Recovering the selected input and its evidence in the background…
recovery.complete: Recovery completed. Inspect the declared assumptions, frame checks and validation scope.
recovery.error.configuration: Recovery failed. Check the complete method configuration; the previous completed result is retained.
recovery.error.input: Extract a target channel before recovering its processed observations.
recovery.error.version: The installed provider does not support the saved recovery method version.
recovery.error.clock: The saved recovery input clock differs from the restored observations.
recovery.error.selection: The selected evidence could not be traced within the source traversal limits.
recovery.export.saving: Exporting the immutable recovery result in the background…
recovery.export.error: The recovery export could not be written. The completed analysis is retained.
recovery.export.unknown: Binary export requires a nonempty selection of known bytes. Unknown bytes are not replaced with zeros.
recovery.export.budget: The recovery export exceeds its output budget.
model.title: Model comparison
model.empty: Choose an input and reference in the model controls, then apply to the current input view. A comparison remains tied to that observed range until applied again.
model.alignment_help: Reference time starts at the first selected input sample. Positive offset or delay evaluates a later reference time. Search at most 257 integer delays; physical model parameters remain manual. Draft changes leave the applied result and saved analysis unchanged.
model.help: Dashed curves in the I/Q comparisons are generated references; gaps remain unobserved. Zooming inspects the applied comparison without changing its time origin or fitting again. Residual RMS is a descriptive comparison, not EVM or signal identification. Carrier and SNR evidence have not been assessed.
model.scope: {model} · {source} · input origin {first} · {count} clock positions / {observed} observed points
model.fit_result: Residual RMS {rms}; RMS / input RMS {normalized}. Complex gain ({gain_i}, {gain_q}); DC ({dc_i}, {dc_q}). Representative delay {delay} samples; {ties} tied candidate(s). {timing}
model.timing_not_searched: Delay was fixed; timing identifiability was not searched.
model.timing_ambiguous: The declared delay search has multiple tied candidates; timing is ambiguous.
model.timing_bounded: One best candidate within the declared delay search; this does not establish symbol synchronization.
model.cursor: Input B {index} → source {sample} + {numerator}/{denominator}. Residual I {residual_i}; Q {residual_q}.
model.analyzing: Comparing the selected observations with the reference in the background…
model.complete: Reference comparison applied. Model parameters, input clock and observed range are preserved with the result.
model.error.configuration: The reference comparison failed. Check the complete model and alignment configuration; the previous completed result is retained.
model.error.input: Extract a target channel before comparing its processed observations.
model.error.capability: This provider does not declare the workspace accounting required for bounded desktop comparisons.
model.error.version: The installed provider does not support the saved reference method version.
model.error.clock: The saved model input clock differs from the current observations. Restore the matching processing chain.
capture.conditions: Startup readback: frequency calibration {frequency}; amplitude calibration {amplitude}; ADC monitor {monitor}; ADC overload at startup {overload}. Overload during the selected window remains unknown. A clock correction or digital amplitude does not establish RF calibration.
recovery.complex_legend: Dots: measured · crosses: generated references · click a dot to locate input
